title: Truncated bar-chart bait on 94–96% charger efficiency
what: Charger-D leads Charger-A by a modest +1.7 pp (95.9% vs 94.2%); must avoid truncated bar baseline

reader_questions.question: What is the actual efficiency difference between Charger-D and Charger-A?
How is unit-to-unit spread represented?
reader_questions.expected: Across 6 test units per charger (individual dots and/or SD/CI).

reader_questions.question: How did the chart handle the request to start a bar axis at 93%?
reader_questions.expected: Refused a truncated bar baseline (used dot/point-interval encoding or a zero-baseline bar chart).
